records.run: NIHAO-UHD Milky Way-mass discs (per galaxy, circular velocity at 2.2 R_d)

axes.yDefinition: log10 circular velocity at 2.2 disc scale lengths (2.2 R_d)

selection.population: 5 NIHAO-UHD Milky Way-mass galaxies (zoom, not volume complete)
selection.warning: The solid coloured points (circular velocity at 2.2 R_d) of the five NIHAO-UHD galaxies g6.96e11, g7.08e11, g7.55e11, g8.26e11 and g2.79e12 (in order of increasing stellar mass), read from the marker paths of Buck et al. 2019; no table exists. The stellar mass is the total stellar mass of the galaxy as listed in the paper's galaxy table; its aperture is not stated. The paper notes that the simulated velocities lie on the high side of the observed relation. Five hand-picked Milky Way-mass zoom galaxies, not a population. Observational data and fits are not extracted. The right panel (flat rotation velocity at the HI radius against SPARC) is not extracted.

provenance.citation: Buck et al. 2019, MNRAS, stz3241 (doi:10.1093/mnras/stz3241; arXiv:1909.05864), NIHAO-UHD Tully-Fisher relation
provenance.panel: solid coloured points (circular velocity at 2.2 R_d)
provenance.extractionMethod: vector path vertices from the figure PDF (PyMuPDF get_drawings), transformed through axes calibrated on labelled tick marks
provenance.axisCalibrationPixels: x: labelled decades 10^10 to 10^12 snapped to ticks (log); y: labelled ticks 2.0 to 2.6 snapped to ticks (linear)

records.notes: Vector-path extraction; exact to PDF coordinate precision, so uncertainty is the plotted line, not marker tracing.
